format_traits.blob_layout: [640 Q4_K gate rows][640 Q4_K up rows][2560 Q5_1 down rows], no inter-segment padding in NativeFmt

scratch_and_outputs.act[t]: Q8_K packed vector, 2920 bytes per token
scratch_and_outputs.hq[t]: Q8_1 packed vector, 720 bytes per token

pipeline: caller provides x[t] as 2560 F32 values
native_quant_act emits Q8_K for Q4_K gate/up
native_gu_rows reads gate rows at blob and up rows at blob+921600, then emits F32 SiLU(gate dot)*up dot
caller passes that F32 intermediate through native_quant_h, producing Q8_1 for Q5_1 down
native_down_rows consumes Q8_1 and emits F32 output
execution_contract.rows: Both row APIs operate on half-open [r0,r1) ranges and do not create threads; for a single-thread reference call full ranges [0,640) and [0,2560).
execution_contract.tokens: nt is the number of token pointers; act[t], ff[t], hq[t], out[t] each address a separate token vector. Scalar ggml fallback loops rows and tokens.
execution_contract.single_token: nt=1 uses ggml CPU vec_dot fallback for Q4_K gate/up and Q5_1 down, including the ggml activation quantizer callbacks.
execution_contract.multitoken: With STRATA_KQ256 unset/0, Q4_K and Q5_1 stay on the per-token ggml-cpu dots for any nt. With STRATA_KQ256=1 and runtime AVX2, nt>=2 selects KQ kernels; headers/comments state bit-exact versus ggml dots.
execution_contract.STRATA_IQ_MT_MIN: Only controls IQ multi-token routes. It does not set Q4_K or Q5_1 thresholds; KQ routes use nt>=2.
execution_contract.static_environment: STRATA_KQ256, STRATA_NO_Q8K_AVX2 and IQ switches are function-local static cached; a future harness must set its child-process environment before its first API call.
execution_contract.canonical_reference_mode: For the uncomplicated ggml-cpu quantized reference, use a fresh process with STRATA_KQ256 unset/0 and call per-token or batched with ggml fallback; do not replace native_quant_h with float down input.
